name: Cymbal

beschreibung.text: Crash-like cymbal: noise and a six-square metal layer, resonant filter, high-pass, distortion and a long hall.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `drums.cymbal`, Welsh [B1] p. 88, patch Cymbal, table transcribed; the author's own note calls it the least realistic patch in the book.. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Manifest character words outside the vocabulary: harsh (as aggressive).
